sites.title: Mac timer that stays always on top | Super Easy Timer
sites.description: Super Easy Timer is a Mac countdown timer you start by typing "5 min". Show it full screen, float it on top, or keep it in the menu bar. It stays visible over full screen apps and presentations like Keynote and PowerPoint. Free.
sites.home_text:
Skip to content 
 Super Easy Timer Get the Mac app macOS 15+ 
A timer that stays on top of every window. 
Keep it visible while you work, present it full screen, or read the
 countdown from across the room.
 4.7 ★ 
on the Mac App Store
 Other download options · Try the free web timer 
No fiddling. Just type. 
Skip the dials and scroll wheels. Type "5 min", "20 minutes", "2h 30m", or "25" and press Return. Need a countdown to a clock time? Type "5pm". Add time as you go with "Add 5 min" without restarting. The new modes work the same way: type "pomodoro", "tabata", "stopwatch", or "clock". 
Keep the countdown visible 
Keep it in the menu bar so the time sits at the top of your screen, or tuck it into a corner while you work. The timer gets out of the way and stays glanceable. Control it from any app with global keyboard shortcuts. 
A timer that floats on top 
Float the timer over every app and keep it in view while you work and switch windows. It stays on top of full screen apps and presentations too, including Keynote, PowerPoint, and Zoom, without stealing focus. 
Show how much time is left 
Make it a full screen countdown everyone in the room can read. Clear digits, no clutter. Built for classes, talks, meetings, webinars, and shared screens. 
Make the timer yours 
Pick from transparent, frosted, Liquid Glass, blue, red, black, white, and cream. Controls and the text input fade away while you work, then come back when you need them. 
Repeat timers, count up, and alarms 
Set repeat timers with an optional delay for breaks, routines, and sessions. Count up after zero to see how far overtime you are. Restart automatically, flash the timer, and choose how many times the alarm repeats. 
Made for people who need timers 
Speakers and teachers keep their talk on time. Focus sessions stay on
 track. Meetings and standups end when they should. Workouts, cooking, and
 routines get a simple repeat timer. One timer, every place you need to see
 the time.
Why I made this 
Hi, I'm Paul. 
Some days I look up and wonder where the time went. That is why I made
 Super Easy Timer. The other timers I tried were clunky, or they crashed
 right when I needed them. I wanted one that starts fast, stays on
 screen, and gets out of the way while I work.
I use it every day. To stay focused. To catch a meeting. To leave on
 time to pick up my daughter. For years I wanted a timer that stays
 visible over full screen apps. That took a long time to get right. Now
 it just works.
I built it for myself, and I keep making it better so it works for you
 too. It is free right now. I hope it helps you be more productive and
 stay on time.
Paul Solt, maker of Super Easy Timer 
 4.7 ★

apps.name: Super Easy Slides
apps.desc:
Super Easy Slides is a Markdown slide deck app for macOS—a simpler alternative when you just want to present, without fighting Keynote or PowerPoint layouts.

No dragging text boxes or fighting alignment. Your formatting stays consistent.

One clean, readable look by default with consistent formatting—so you don’t accidentally nudge content out of alignment, delete a box, or end up with mismatched slides. Focus on your message; your slides stay neat and readable.

Write in plain Markdown, and Super Easy Slides turns headings and lists into slides with consistent formatting and automatic numbering. Preview as you type, then present in Full Screen or use a floating overlay slideshow (slides over any app) while you walk through a demo or screencast.

Built-in slide generator: automatically renumber slides and generate new slides based on your Markdown and configuration options.
